scripts.speaker: Ore Tester Sorty
scripts.text:
Do you have ^3131FFany same type of ores in your inventories^000000 which take many spaces?
I can distinguish your ores and organize them right away~!

scripts.speaker: Ore Tester Sorty
scripts.text:
At the moment I can only distinguish ^FF0000Steel^000000, ^FF0000Iron^000000, ^FF0000Iron Ore^000000, and ^FF0000Rough Oridecon^000000 and organize them.

scripts.speaker: Ore Tester Sorty
scripts.text: So, would you like me to organize your ores?

scripts.speaker: Ore Tester Sorty
scripts.text: Huh, I really hate messy people!

scripts.speaker: Ore Tester Sorty
scripts.text: It's done. Looks great! Don't you think so?

scripts.speaker: Ore Tester Sorty
scripts.text: It seems that your bag is clean? Huhu! You might be the master of cleaning!
